description: Stock solutions of IAA and NAA were prepared in 95% ethanol and K-NAA in water, stored appropriately, and diluted into cooled NGM agar plates seeded with E. coli OP50 for auxin treatment experiments.
goal: to prepare auxin-containing media for degradation experiments

title: Perform auxin treatment in liquid and microfluidic platforms
description: Fresh NAA or K-NAA solutions were prepared in M9 buffer with or without bacteria for liquid-based and microfluidic auxin-mediated degradation experiments, with controls using M9 buffer or bacteria alone.
goal: to induce protein degradation via auxin in liquid and microfluidic conditions

title: Construct pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids
description: Cloning synthetic gDNAs between two tracrRNA-complementary repeat regions in the pCRISPR-SacB plasmid to generate plasmids encoding guide RNAs for Cas9 targeting.
goal: to create plasmids encoding RNA guides for Cas9 cleavage

title: Test gDNA efficiency by transformation and colony counting
description: Transform E. coli with pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids and compare transformation efficiencies to the empty pCRISPR vector to assess the effectiveness of gDNAs in promoting Cas9 cleavage.
goal: to evaluate the quality of gDNAs based on transformation efficiency
key_materials: LB plates with Cm and Km

title: Analyze plasmid and chromosomal sequences post-transformation
description: Randomly select colonies from transformations and analyze both chromosomal target sites and plasmid gDNA regions by PCR and sequencing to detect mutations or plasmid rearrangements.
goal: to confirm Cas9 cleavage and plasmid integrity

title: Optimize gene knockout conditions using donor DNA
description: Test different lengths (70 and 120 bp), concentrations (10 μg), and types (ss-dDNA targeting lagging or leading strand, ds-dDNA) of donor DNA to determine efficiency of gene deletions of varying sizes.
goal: to identify optimal donor DNA parameters for efficient gene inactivation

title: Validate gene deletion efficiency across multiple loci
description: Apply optimized donor DNA conditions to target multiple gene loci and measure mutation efficiencies by analyzing at least 20 colonies per experiment.
goal: to confirm robustness and efficiency of gene deletions at different loci
key_materials: pCRISPR plasmids targeting ompF, fecA, lpp genes

title: Generate and test 78 pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmids for dispensable genes
description: Construct plasmids encoding gRNAs targeting 78 dispensable genes near their 5' ends and verify gDNA effectiveness by transformation and colony counting.
goal: to create a mutant library targeting dispensable genes

title: Perform 30 bp deletions with 70 bp ss-dDNAs in 78 genes
description: Transform E. coli with each pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmid and corresponding 70 bp ss-dDNA to delete 30 bp and introduce premature stop codons, then analyze 10 colonies per gene by PCR to assess mutagenesis efficiency.
goal: to validate the efficiency of short gene deletions for mutant library production

title: CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing protocol setup
description: This task involves using the pCasRed plasmid encoding Cas9 nuclease and λ Red cassette, the pCRISPR-SacB-gDNA plasmid carrying the kanamycin resistance and sacB gene, and synthetic donor DNA to perform genome editing in E. coli. The sacB gene allows plasmid curing by sucrose toxicity after mutation introduction.
goal: to perform CRISPR/Cas9-based genome editing in E. coli

title: Prepare PLX5622 and control chow
description: PLX5622 was formulated at 300 ppm in AIN-76A standard chow. Mice ingested approximately 1.2 mg of PLX5622 per day based on 4 g chow consumption.
goal: to provide drug-containing and control diets for mice

title: Treat mice with chow and perform cranial irradiation
description: C57BL/6J male mice were treated with PLX5622 or control chow for 21 days starting at 8 weeks old. Cranial irradiation was performed starting 7 days after drug treatment initiation using fractionated doses totaling 10 Gy with shielding to protect non-target tissues.
goal: to treat mice with drug and apply cranial irradiation

title: Perform novel object recognition (NOR) test
description: Mice were habituated and tested in an open arena with objects over 4 days. Exploration times of familiar and novel objects were recorded and analyzed to assess recognition memory.
goal: to assess recognition memory in mice

title: Conduct delayed matching-to-place (DMP) dry maze test
description: Mice were tested in a Barnes maze with 40 holes and a single escape hole covered by a dark tube. Four trials per day were conducted with intervals, and mice were guided if they failed to find the escape hole within 90 seconds.
goal: to measure spatial working memory

title: Perform metric distance test
description: Mice were tested over two days with habituation and three trials each day involving exploration of object pairs at varying distances. Exploration times were recorded to assess hippocampal function.
goal: to measure hippocampal function

title: Isolate brain cells and perform flow cytometry
description: Brains were perfused and dissociated into single cells. Cells were separated by Percoll gradient centrifugation, blocked, stained with antibodies, and analyzed by flow cytometry to identify immune cell populations.
goal: to analyze brain immune cells by flow cytometry

title: Perform Golgi staining of brain hemispheres
description: Brain hemispheres were incubated in Golgi staining solution for 14 days, cryoprotected in sucrose, sectioned at 100 μm, mounted, developed, and imaged to analyze dendritic spine density.
goal: to visualize and quantify dendritic spines

title: Analyze behavioral and cellular data statistically
description: Data from behavioral tests and cellular analyses were analyzed using appropriate ANOVA tests with post hoc comparisons or t-tests. Results were plotted with GraphPad Prism.
goal: to statistically analyze experimental results

title: Worm Strain Culturing and Maintenance
description: Worms were grown and maintained on nematode growth media plates seeded with E. coli (OP50) at 20°C. Various worm strains were created by crossing and genetic manipulation.
goal: to culture and maintain worm strains for experiments

title: CRISPR-Cas9 Genome Editing
description: CRISPR-Cas9 was used to create GFP-tagged rad-51 and spo-11 mutations in specific worm strains. The GFP tag was added to the N-terminus of RAD-51, and spo-11 deletions or insertions were generated and confirmed by DAPI body counts.
goal: to create GFP-tagged rad-51 and spo-11 mutant worm strains

title: Live Worm Imaging
description: Live worms were imaged using fluorescence microscopy with specific exposure settings. Nuclei were located based on GFP fluorescence, and time series imaging was performed to monitor foci dynamics after microirradiation.
goal: to image live worms and monitor fluorescent foci dynamics

title: Image Processing and Foci Scoring
description: Imaged stacks were processed to create maximum projections. Foci in nuclei were scored for number and size, with clusters defined by diameter >0.6 μm. Background fluorescence and worm viability during imaging were also assessed.
goal: to quantify and analyze fluorescent foci in live imaging data

title: Fixed Slide Imaging and Analysis
description: Fixed slides were imaged using wide-field fluorescence microscopy and deconvolved. Gonad length and foci locations were recorded and analyzed, with focus clusters identified by size criteria.
goal: to image and analyze fixed worm gonads for foci distribution

title: Microirradiation of Germline Nuclei
description: Target nuclei in germline regions were microirradiated with a single laser pulse at specified intensities. Multiple nuclei per gonad were targeted, and worms were recovered for subsequent analysis.
goal: to induce DNA damage in specific germline nuclei via microirradiation

title: Live Imaging Slide Preparation and Worm Recovery
description: Worms were mounted on agarose pads or in imaging petri dishes with M9 and polystyrene beads for live imaging and microirradiation. After imaging, worms were recovered by removing coverslips or agarose pads and placed on NGM plates.
goal: to prepare worms for live imaging and recover them post-microirradiation

title: Immunofluorescent Staining of Gonads
description: Dissected worm gonads were fixed and stained with specific primary and secondary antibodies to detect proteins of interest. Gonads were also stained with DAPI to visualize DNA.
goal: to detect and visualize specific proteins in worm gonads by immunofluorescence
key_materials: Primary antibodies: Rabbit anti-RAD-51, Chicken anti-GFP, Rabbit anti-HIM-8, Goat anti-SYP-1

title: Animal Housing and Food Restriction
description: Male 3-month old BALB/cARC and C57BL/6JARC mice were housed in groups of four in ventilated cages with bedding under controlled temperature, humidity, and light cycle. Mice were food-restricted to 90% of their free-feeding body weight by adjusting daily food amounts, with ad libitum access to water.
goal: to maintain mice under controlled environmental conditions and food restriction for behavioral testing

title: Touchscreen Apparatus Setup and Cleaning
description: Operant chambers equipped with touchscreen, house light, reward dispenser, and magazine were used for testing. Chambers were housed in sound-attenuating boxes with overhead cameras. The touchscreen and related components were cleaned with 70% ethanol between animals, and reward lines flushed with warm water daily.
goal: to prepare and maintain touchscreen apparatus for behavioral testing

title: Touchscreen Training with Liquid Reward
description: Mice were acclimated to a liquid reward by providing strawberry milk in their home cage for 3 days. They were habituated to the testing room before progressing through touchscreen training stages including Habituation, Initial Touch, Must Touch Stimuli, Must Initiate, and Punish Incorrect, with modifications to increase trial pace and reduce distractions.
goal: to train mice to use the touchscreen and respond to stimuli for reward

title: Visual Discrimination (VD) Task
description: Mice were tested to discriminate between two visual stimuli, with one stimulus rewarded. They had to complete 100 trials within 60 minutes and achieve at least 80% correct. Correction trials were used to prevent side bias. After acquisition, reversal testing was conducted by switching reward contingencies.
goal: to assess visual discrimination learning and behavioral flexibility

title: Open Field Locomotor Activity Test
description: Mice were individually placed in a square chamber equipped with infrared beams to track movement. The chamber was cleaned with 70% ethanol between animals. Total distance traveled and percent time spent in the center were recorded over a 30-minute session.
goal: to measure locomotor activity and anxiety-related behavior
key_materials: square Perspex chambers (27 × 27 × 20 cm, Med Associates Inc.)

title: Forced Swim Test (FST)
description: Mice were placed individually in a water-filled cylindrical vessel for 10 minutes while activity was recorded by overhead camera. After testing, mice were dried before returning to home cage. Videos were analyzed to measure total distance traveled and immobility duration.
goal: to assess behavioral despair

title: Statistical Analysis of Behavioral Data
description: Behavioral data were analyzed using independent t-tests, ANOVA, or repeated measures ANOVA with Bonferroni correction. Greenhouse-Geisser correction was applied when necessary. Statistical significance was set at p < 0.05.
goal: to analyze behavioral outcomes and determine statistical significance

title: Setup Touchscreen Apparatus
description: Operant chambers equipped with touchscreen, house light, reward dispenser, and magazine were placed inside sound-attenuating boxes with overhead cameras. Infrared beams detected responses. The mask, touchscreen, grid floor, and tray were cleaned with 70% ethanol between animals, and reward lines flushed with warm water daily.
goal: to prepare and maintain the operant chambers for behavioral testing

title: Cell culture maintenance
description: DT40, Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) cells were maintained as described previously.

title: iChIP and in vitro enChIP procedures
description: Non-KI(B), KI(B), and KI(MΦ) cells were subjected to the iChIP procedure, and DT40 cells were subjected to the in vitro enChIP procedure. Chromatin DNA was fragmented (~2 kbp), target regions isolated, DNA purified, libraries prepared (selecting ~0.4 kbp fragments), and sequenced using the HiSeq platform. Data were analyzed using ELAND, MACS2, and IGV.
goal: to isolate and sequence target chromatin regions

title: Plasmid construction for sgRNA expression
description: Cas9 and sgRNA expression plasmids were obtained. sgRNA plasmids were constructed by cloning double-stranded DNA encoding target sequences downstream of the U6 promoter or by synthesizing DNA fragments coding the U6 promoter, target sequence, gRNA scaffold, and termination signal.
key_materials: GeneArt gene synthesis services (Thermo Fisher Scientific)

title: CRISPR-mediated genomic locus deletion
description: DT40 cells were transfected with Cas9, sgRNA plasmids targeting genomic region ends, and pEGFP-N3 by electroporation. GFP-positive cells were sorted and expanded. Genomic DNA was extracted and genotyping PCR performed to confirm deletion using specific primers.
goal: to delete target genomic loci

title: RNA extraction and quantitative RT-PCR
description: Total RNA was extracted and quantitative RT-PCR was performed as described previously using specific primers.

title: Chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) assays
description: ChIP assays were performed on DT40 cells using antibodies against H3K4me1, H3K27ac, and histone H3. Purified DNA was used as template for real-time PCR with SYBR Select Master Mix on a real-time PCR system using specific primers.
key_materials: Applied Biosystems 7900HT Fast Real-Time PCR System

title: DSS treatment of mice
description: C57BL/6 mice were group housed under controlled temperature and photoperiod, given unrestricted access to chow and water containing 3% DSS for 7 days, then sacrificed by CO2 euthanasia. A 50 mg piece of proximal colon was collected for RNA extraction.
goal: to treat mice with DSS and collect colon tissue for RNA extraction

title: RNA extraction from colon tissue
description: Total RNA was isolated from colonic tissues using TRIzol reagent following the manufacturer's instructions. RNA integrity was assessed by 2% agarose gel electrophoresis.
goal: to isolate total RNA from colon tissue

title: Lithium chloride RNA purification
description: RNA samples were incubated with 0.1 volume of 8 M LiCl on ice for 2 hours, centrifuged, and pellets dissolved in RNase-free water. This incubation and centrifugation were repeated once. RNA was precipitated at -20°C with sodium acetate and ethanol, centrifuged, washed with 70% ethanol, and dissolved in RNase-free water.
goal: to purify RNA from polysaccharides including DSS contamination

title: cDNA synthesis and qPCR quantification
description: cDNA was synthesized from total RNA using the Maxima First-Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit. Expression levels were quantified by qPCR using SYBR Green/ROX Master Mix and specific primers for 36B4 gene.
goal: to synthesize cDNA and quantify gene expression by qPCR
key_materials: Maxima First-Strand cDNA Synthesis Kit (Thermo Scientific)
Maxima SYBR Green/ROX qPCR Master Mix (Thermo Scientific)

title: Polymerase enzymatic activity assay
description: Recombinant Taq DNA polymerase was incubated with water or varying concentrations of DSS (0.01 to 1 g/L), with dextran as control. Polymerase activity was measured by fluorescence every minute for 60 minutes at 72°C elongation step.
goal: to measure polymerase enzymatic activity in presence of DSS
key_materials: EvaEZ Fluorometric Polymerase Activity Assay kit (Biotium)

title: Measure polymerase enzymatic activity
description: 0.01 units of recombinant Taq DNA polymerase were incubated with water or DSS (0.01 to 1 g/L) and dextran as control. The enzymatic activity was quantified by fluorescence measured every 1 min for 60 min during the elongation step at 72°C using a thermal cycler.
goal: to measure polymerase enzymatic activity
key_materials: EvaEZ™ Fluorometric Polymerase Activity Assay kit

title: Measure reverse transcriptase enzymatic activity
description: 0.4 units of M-MuLV reverse transcriptase were incubated at 25°C with water or DSS (0.00005 g/L or 0.0005 g/L) in the presence of a standardized polyA RNA template, oligodT, and polymerization buffer. Enzymatic activity was quantified by fluorescence using a microplate reader.
goal: to measure reverse transcriptase enzymatic activity

title: Perform surface plasmon resonance (SPR) binding assay
description: Gold sensor chips covered with carboxydextran were activated with EDC/NHS to form amide linkages with purified M-MuLV reverse transcriptase. The chip was coated with reverse transcriptase, then primed RNA (with or without DSS at various concentrations) was flowed over the chip twice. Binding interactions were monitored in real time by measuring resonance angle deflection (laser deviation angle) to assess binding affinity.
goal: to assess binding affinity between reverse transcriptase and primed RNA with or without DSS

title: Isolate plasma cells and antibody-secreting cells
description: Plasma cells were obtained from synovial fluid of an anti-CCP–positive RA patient, and antibody-secreting cells were isolated from synovial fluid mononuclear cells using the fluorescent foci method.
goal: to isolate plasma cells and antibody-secreting cells from synovial fluid

title: Sort single citrulline-specific B cells by flow cytometry
description: Single citrulline-specific B cells were sorted by flow cytometry from peripheral blood of RA patients using an antigen-tetramer system.
goal: to isolate single citrulline-specific B cells

title: Perform peptide ELISA for antibody binding
description: Peptide ELISAs assessed binding of monoclonal antibodies to citrulline- and arginine-containing peptides including filaggrin, α-enolase, vimentin, fibrinogen, and histones. mAb were added at 5 μg/ml and serially diluted down to 0.15 ng/ml. Reactive samples were analyzed in at least 3 independent experiments.
goal: to assess antibody binding to citrulline- and arginine-containing peptides

title: Conduct full-length protein ELISA with citrullination
description: Full-length proteins were coated on 96-well plates, blocked with 5% milk in PBS, and incubated with citrullination buffer containing hPAD2 or buffer control at 37°C for 3 hours. Plates were then incubated with ACPAs at 5 μg/ml serially diluted to 0.15 ng/ml, followed by sequential incubation with secondary antibodies and development with TMB substrate. Results were read using Spectra Fluor.
goal: to detect antibody binding to citrullinated full-length proteins

title: Synthesize extracellular matrix peptide microarray
description: Peptides covering all arginine and lysine sites of 1,610 extracellular matrix and RA-related proteins were synthesized in situ, including citrulline and homocitrulline variants, resulting in a total of 172,765 unique peptides.

title: Dilute monoclonal antibodies and samples
description: Monoclonal antibodies were diluted to 1 μg/ml (except mAb 1325:07E07 at 0.55 μg/ml), and synovial fluid and serum samples were diluted 1/100 for subsequent analysis.

title: Scan peptide microarray for antibody reactivity
description: Scanning for citrulline and homocitrulline reactivity with each monoclonal antibody was performed at 2 μm resolution, calculating median fluorescence intensities based on a 25-pixel spot size. Positive signals were defined as 5 times the fluorescence intensity of the 98th percentile of non-ACPA mAb values.

title: Perform Western blot analysis
description: Full-length proteins were solubilized in 8 M urea, electrophoresed on 12.5% SDS-PAGE gels, and transferred to nitrocellulose membranes. Membranes were incubated overnight at 37°C with citrullination buffer containing hPAD2 or buffer control, followed by incubation with ACPAs and secondary antibody. Visualization was performed using Amersham Hyperfilm.

title: Preparation of cell-conditioned medium
description: Cells were cultured in DMEM with 10% fetal bovine serum at 37°C and 5% CO2 or in serum-free formulations. Recombinant ribonuclease inhibitor was added at 4–8 U/ml during medium renewal or after collection of conditioned media.

title: Ultracentrifugation of cell-conditioned medium
description: Cell-conditioned medium previously centrifuged at 2000 × g was ultracentrifuged at 100,000 × g for 2.5 hours at 4°C. The supernatant was concentrated to approximately 250 μl using ultrafiltration units and then subjected to size-exclusion chromatography or RNA extraction with TRIzol.

title: Size-exclusion chromatography of extracellular fractions
description: The 100,000 × g supernatants were concentrated by ultrafiltration with PBS to remove phenol red and small molecules. Concentrated EV-depleted fractions (500 μl) were injected into a Superdex S200 column and chromatographed at 0.9 ml/min in filtered PBS. Samples were centrifuged at 16,000 × g before injection. Fractions of 0.25 ml were collected while monitoring absorbance at 260 and 280 nm. Chromatograms were deconvoluted in silico using empirically determined 260/280 ratios from BSA and synthetic tRNA Gly GCC 5′ halves.

title: Sequencing of small RNAs
description: RNA was purified from selected chromatographic peaks using TRIzol LS. The RNA was diluted in RNase-free water and used as input for next-generation sequencing library preparation. Sequencing was performed for 200 cycles on a MiSeq sequencer. Data analysis was performed as described in supplementary materials.
key_materials: NEBNext Small RNA Library Prep Set for Illumina

title: Northern blotting of RNA samples
description: Northern blots were performed using 10% denaturing gels transferred to nylon membranes. Detection was based on digoxigenin-labeled DNA probes and alkaline phosphatase-labeled anti-digoxigenin antibody. Signals were visualized with CDP-Star and detected using a ChemiDoc imaging system.

title: Differentiation of dendritic cells and flow cytometry analysis
description: Adherent BMDCs were prepared as described in reference 26. Selected chromatographic fractions or synthetic RNAs were added to 1 × 10^6 BMDCs. After 24 hours, cells were harvested and analyzed by flow cytometry.

title: Morphology and Marker Analysis of iPS-DCregs
description: Compared morphology and expression of co-stimulatory molecules and MHC class II antigens between iPS-DCregs and BM-DCregs, assessing their immature stage.
goal: to characterize the stable immature stage of iPS-DCregs

title: Antigen Uptake Assay under IFN-γ Stimulation
description: Tested antigen uptake ability of iPS-DCregs under IFN-γ stimulation using FITC-labeled OVA and dextran to confirm maintenance of immature stage.
goal: to verify stable immature stage of iPS-DCregs under IFN-γ

title: mRNA Expression Analysis of Suppressive Cytokines
description: Measured mRNA levels of suppressive cytokines in iPS-DCregs compared to BM-DCcons to assess immunosuppressive characteristics.
goal: to identify suppressive cytokine expression in iPS-DCregs

title: Allogeneic Mixed Lymphocyte Reaction (MLR) for Direct Regulation
description: Set up allogeneic MLR to test direct antigen-presenting regulatory function of iPS-DCregs by measuring T cell proliferation inhibition.
goal: to examine direct regulatory function of iPS-DCregs
key_materials: naive T cells from CBA mice

title: OVA-Specific MLR for Indirect Regulation
description: Established OVA-specific MLR to investigate indirect antigen-presenting regulatory ability of iPS-DCregs by assessing T cell proliferation.
goal: to investigate indirect regulatory ability of iPS-DCregs

title: In Vivo Proliferation Lymph Node Assay (PLNA)
description: Injected OVA-pulsed BM-DCcons with or without iPS-DCregs into mice footpads to assess in vivo T cell proliferation regulation.
goal: to test in vivo regulatory function of iPS-DCregs

title: Immunization and Secondary In Vitro MLR
description: Immunized mice with B6 DCs, isolated spleen cells, and performed secondary MLR to evaluate Treg generation and Teff suppression.
goal: to assess Treg induction and Teff suppression by iPS-DCregs

title: Donor-Type DCregs Injection and Cardiac Allograft Survival
description: Injected different DCregs types into recipients before heart transplantation to evaluate allograft survival and rejection.
goal: to assess donor-type iPS-DCregs in preventing allograft rejection
key_materials: CBA BM-DCregs pulsed with H-2Kb peptide

title: Grow petunia plants in greenhouse
description: Rooted petunia plantlets were obtained and grown in a greenhouse under controlled temperature (25/20°C day/night) and a 12/12 h light/dark photoperiod starting at 0800 h.
key_materials: Petunia x hybrida L. lines P720, W115, Blue Spark, Blue Ray

title: Collect petunia flowers for volatile analysis
description: Flowers at different developmental stages were collected at specific times for dynamic headspace analysis and diel floral emission studies.
goal: to collect flowers for volatile scent compound analysis

title: Collect emitted volatiles using Porapak Q traps
description: Volatiles emitted from detached flowers were trapped on Porapak Q polymer tubes, eluted with hexane, and iso butylbenzene was added as an internal standard for GC–MS analysis.
goal: to collect emitted volatiles for GC–MS analysis

title: Extract free volatile compounds from petals
description: Petal tissues were ground in liquid nitrogen and extracted in hexane containing iso butylbenzene, incubated with shaking, centrifuged, and the supernatant was prepared for chromatography.
goal: to extract free volatile scent compounds

title: Extract glycosylated scent compounds from petals
description: Petal tissues were ground, suspended in methanol-water, sonicated, centrifuged, vacuum-dried, resuspended in buffer, hydrolyzed overnight with Viscozyme enzyme, then extracted with hexane containing iso butylbenzene for GC–MS analysis.
goal: to extract and hydrolyze glycosylated scent compounds

title: Perform GC–MS analysis of scent compounds
description: Samples were injected into GC–MS with specified temperature programs and conditions; compounds were identified by spectral library matching and authentic standards.
goal: to analyze and identify scent compounds by GC–MS

title: Conduct 2H5-Phe feeding experiments on detached flowers
description: Detached corollas were incubated in 2H5-Phe solution, washed, transferred to water, and sampled at various time points to detect labeled and non-labeled glycosylated scent compounds.
goal: to trace incorporation of labeled phenylalanine into scent compounds

title: Transiently overexpress AnBGL1 in petunia flowers
description: Petunia buds were vacuum infiltrated with Agrobacterium carrying AnBGL1 constructs or control GFP, incubated, and GFP-positive tissues were analyzed for glycosylated scent compounds and β-glucosidase activity.
goal: to transiently express β-glucosidase in petunia flowers

title: Synthesis of desthiobiotin derivatives of thiazole orange acetate
description: TO1-Dtb and TO3-Dtb were synthesized using TO1-acetate and TO3-acetate respectively, with EZ link amine PEG4 desthiobiotin as precursors following an established protocol. Product identity was confirmed by electrospray ionization–mass spectrometry.
goal: to synthesize desthiobiotin derivatives of thiazole orange acetate
key_materials: EZ link amine PEG4 desthiobiotin (Thermo Fisher)

title: Preparation of TO1-Dtb derivatized streptavidin agarose resin
description: Streptavidin agarose beads were washed with Buffer A and Buffer B, then incubated with TO1-Dtb in Buffer B for 15 min at room temperature. Beads were washed to remove unbound dye.
goal: to prepare TO1-Dtb derivatized streptavidin agarose affinity resin

title: Yeast strain construction and extract preparation
description: The U1M gene was subcloned into pRS413 and transformed into yeast strain yAAH0441. Transformants were selected and confirmed by PCR and sequencing. A double-tagged strain was created by homologous recombination. Yeast whole-cell extracts were prepared using liquid nitrogen and a ball mill.
goal: to construct yeast strains and prepare whole-cell extracts

title: SNAP labeling of yeast whole-cell extract
description: Yeast whole-cell extracts were incubated with SNAP-Surface 549 tag, RNase inhibitor, protease inhibitors, and DTT in Buffer B at room temperature for 30 min to fluorescently label the extracts.
goal: to fluorescently label yeast whole-cell extracts with SNAP tag

title: Pull-down of U1M-associated snRNPs
description: Yeast extracts were incubated with TO1-Dtb agarose beads at 4°C for 1 h, washed multiple times with Buffer B, and eluted with Buffer B containing biotin at 37°C. Eluates were concentrated and analyzed by SDS-PAGE and RT-primer extension assay.
goal: to isolate U1M-associated snRNP complexes

title: RNA analysis by RT-primer extension and solution hybridization
description: Precipitated RNA or total RNA was reverse transcribed using labeled primers and Maxima Reverse Transcriptase at 45°C for 1 h, then analyzed on denaturing polyacrylamide gels. For solution hybridization, labeled primers were incubated with RNA and analyzed on native gels at 4°C.
goal: to analyze RNA by reverse transcription and hybridization

title: Construction of p6SRDM_T7 plasmid
description: The 6SRDM plasmid with point mutations was cloned into pEcoli-Cterm-6xHN plasmid between SgrAI and ClaI sites, flanked by T7 promoter and lac operator at 5′ end and intrinsic terminator at 3′ end.
goal: to construct plasmid for 6SRDM RNA expression

title: Expression of 6SRDM RNA in E. coli and extract preparation
description: E. coli transformed with p6SRDM_T7 were grown in LB with ampicillin, induced with IPTG at OD600 ~1, harvested, resuspended in native extract buffer, lysed by French press, centrifuged to remove debris, and native extract was frozen for storage.
goal: to express 6SRDM RNA and prepare native extract

title: Virus Strain Preparation
description: Four DENV strains and other flaviviruses and respiratory viruses were obtained from various sources and stored for use in assay development and cross-reactivity evaluation.
goal: to establish virus stocks for assay development and evaluation
key_materials: Respiratory viruses (adenovirus VR-930, enterovirus VR-1076, influenza A VR-333, influenza B VR-789, parainfluenza virus 3 VR-93, HCoV-229E VR-740, HCoV-OC43 VR-1558, human rhinovirus VR-489)

title: Viral RNA Extraction
description: Viral RNA was extracted from 140 μl of virus culture supernatants or patient plasma using the QIAamp Viral Min Kit, eluted in 50 μl nuclease-free water, and stored at -80°C until use.
goal: to extract viral RNA for downstream assays

title: Mutant Viral RNA Template Construction
description: The 3′-UTR fragment of DENV-4 was amplified and sub-cloned into a plasmid vector with a fused T7 promoter. Site-directed mutagenesis was performed to create mutants with primer mismatches, confirmed by Sanger sequencing. Mutant RNAs were transcribed in vitro and quantified spectrophotometrically.
goal: to generate mutant viral RNA templates for mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP proof-of-concept
key_materials: StarScript II Probe One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (GenStar, Beijing, China)

title: Construct mismatch mutants of DENV-4 3′-UTR
description: The 3′-UTR fragment of DENV-4 was amplified and sub-cloned into a plasmid vector. Site-directed mutagenesis was performed to create mutants forming mismatches with primers, confirmed by Sanger sequencing. Mutant RNAs were transcribed in vitro and quantified by spectrophotometry.
goal: to perform the proof-of-concept experiment of the mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP
key_materials: StarScript II Probe One-Step qRT-PCR Kit (GenStar, Beijing, China)

title: Establish novel mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP assay
description: A 25 μl reaction mix including Bst 2.0 DNA polymerase, WarmStart RT, and optimized Q5 High-Fidelity DNA polymerase was prepared with specific primers and fluorescent dye. The RT-LAMP reaction was performed at 63°C for 60 minutes with real-time fluorescence monitoring.
goal: to establish the novel mismatch-tolerant RT-LAMP system

title: Determine sensitivity and limit of detection (LOD)
description: Ten-fold serial dilutions of RNA from DENV stocks were used to assess sensitivity of the RT-LAMP assay. RNA copy numbers were quantified by RT-qPCR. LOD was determined by testing replicates of serial dilutions and performing probit regression analysis.
goal: to determine the sensitivity and limit of detection of the novel DENV RT-LAMP assay
key_materials: in vitro transcribed DENV RNA standard

title: Evaluate novel RT-LAMP assay with clinical samples
description: Clinical plasma samples were tested for DENV infection by NS1 antigen detection and RT-PCR. Positive samples underwent Sanger sequencing and phylogenetic analysis. Samples with discordant results between assays were further analyzed by RT-nested PCR and sequencing.
goal: to evaluate the performance of the novel RT-LAMP assay for pan-serotype detection of DENV
key_materials: One-Step Dengue NS1 RapiDip™ InstaTest kit
PrimeScript™ One Step RT-PCR Kit Ver.2
StarScript II Probe One-Step qRT-PCR Kit

title: Develop visual detection methods for RT-LAMP
description: Visual detection was developed by adding HNB dye to RT-LAMP reactions and by using a colorimetric master mix with cresol red. Reactions were incubated at 63°C and color changes were observed at multiple time points.
goal: to develop a visual detection method for RT-LAMP assays

title: Grow E. coli strains
description: E. coli NEB5α and BL21(DE3) strains were grown in LB broth with aeration at 250 rpm.
goal: to culture E. coli strains for experiments

title: Transform plasmids into E. coli
description: Plasmids were introduced into E. coli cells by electroporation, and transformants were selected by plating on LB agar containing the appropriate antibiotic and incubated at 37°C overnight.
goal: to introduce plasmids into E. coli cells

title: Grow M. smegmatis strain
description: M. smegmatis MC2 155 was grown in standard 7H9 liquid and 7H10 solid media prior to spot titer assays.
goal: to culture M. smegmatis for experiments

title: Construct plasmids with DnaBi1 insertion
description: M. smegmatis DnaBi1 was inserted in-frame into the kanR gene of pUC4K using Gibson assembly. Plasmids were prepared using a plasmid minikit.
goal: to create plasmids containing DnaBi1 inserted into kanR

title: Construct MIG reporter plasmids
description: MIG reporter plasmids for M. smegmatis and M. leprae DnaBi1 were constructed previously and contain the intein flanked by native DnaB extein residues. Clones were verified by sequencing.

title: Kanamycin intein splicing reporter spot titers
description: Sixteen KanR-DnaBi1 fusion constructs and their splicing-inactive variants were grown on LB media containing carbenicillin and a range of kanamycin concentrations. Survivability was assessed by colony forming units to determine splicing-dependent resistance.
goal: to identify KanR-DnaBi1 constructs requiring splicing for kanamycin resistance

title: In silico analysis of KanR insertion sites
description: The 3D structure of KanR was analyzed to calculate relative solvent-accessible surface area, distances to dimer interface and active site for each serine residue to assess intein insertion site characteristics.

title: M. smegmatis spot titer assays
description: KD154 construct was subcloned into a mycobacterial shuttle vector and used in spot titer assays with two-fold dilutions of cells spotted on 7H10 media. Cells were grown at 30°C for 5 days with varying concentrations of kanamycin and zinc acetate.

title: Purify Polyclonal and Monoclonal Antibodies
description: Polyclonal ACPA IgGs and control IgGs were purified from pooled and non-pooled sera of RA patients. Polyclonal anti-PR3 IgGs and controls were purified from a patient with PR3-associated vasculitis. Monoclonal antibodies were isolated from RA patients and recombinantly expressed as IgG1. All IgGs underwent quality control including specificity, aggregation, and endotoxin tests.
goal: to purify and quality control antibodies for experiments
key_materials: pooled serum of patients with RA
sera of ACPA-positive patients with RA
sera of patient with PR3-associated vasculitis

title: Generate F(ab’)2 Antibody Fragments
description: F(ab’)2 antibody fragments were generated from IgGs. RF IgM antibody was purchased for use in experiments.

title: Culture Synovial and Dermal Fibroblasts
description: Synovial fibroblasts from RA and osteoarthritis patients, as well as human dermal fibroblasts, were cultured for cell culture experiments.

title: Obtain Synovial Biopsies
description: Synovial biopsies were obtained from four healthy volunteers and four RA patients with informed consent under approved ethical protocol.

title: Assess Fibroblast Migration
description: Fibroblast migration was assessed using live cell imaging with IncuCyte Zoom or by performing scratch assays.
key_materials: IncuCyte Zoom live cell imaging system

title: Perform Adhesion Assays
description: Adhesion assays were conducted using 16-well E-plates and the xCELLigence system to monitor cell adhesion in real time.

title: Pretreat IgGs with Citrullinated or Native Proteins
description: ACPA and control IgGs were pretreated overnight at 4°C with citrullinated or native fibrinogen, recombinant vimentin, α-enolase, or histone H4.

title: Inhibit PI3K and PTEN Enzymes
description: Phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K) was inhibited by wortmanin and phosphatase and tensin homolog (PTEN) was inhibited by SF-1670 during experiments.

title: Peptidomics analysis of soybean xylem exudate
description: Performed peptidomics analysis to identify root-to-shoot long-distance mobile peptides in soybean xylem exudate.

title: Nano-LC–MS/MS analysis of Arabidopsis xylem exudate
description: Collected Arabidopsis xylem exudate and performed nano-LC–MS/MS to detect mature CLE2 peptide and confirm its root-to-shoot translocation.
goal: to explore whether the Arabidopsis CLE peptide is translocated from roots to shoots via the xylem

title: Expression analysis of CLE2 under low-carbon conditions
description: Measured CLE2 mRNA levels in plants treated with photosynthesis inhibitor DCMU or prolonged darkness, with or without sucrose application, to assess response to low-carbon conditions.
goal: to examine whether CLE2 responds to low-carbon conditions

title: Sugar and starch content measurement in roots and leaves
description: Measured sugar (sucrose and glucose) and starch contents in roots and leaves of wild-type and various cle mutants to characterize CLE2 function.

title: Generation of cle2cle3 double and cle1-7 septuple mutants
description: Created cle2cle3 double mutant and cle1-7 septuple mutant using CRISPR/Cas9 to analyze overlapping biological activities of CLE peptides.

title: Gain-of-function analysis of CLE2 using CoYMV promoter
description: Generated transgenic lines with ectopic expression of CLE2 under CoYMV promoter to assess effects on sucrose levels in roots and leaves.

title: Application of synthetic mature CLE2 peptide to Arabidopsis
description: Applied synthetic CLE2 peptide to rosette leaves of wild-type and cle1-7 mutant plants and measured starch and sugar contents after 24 hours.

title: Measurement of shoot and root mass in cle mutants
description: Evaluated shoot and root mass and shoot/root mass ratio in cle1-7, cle2, cle3, and cle2cle3 mutants under normal and diurnally fluctuating light conditions with or without sucrose.
goal: to explore the possibility that decreased root sucrose levels affect root growth

title: Prepare Neuronal Cultures from Mouse Embryos
description: Cortical and hippocampal neurons were isolated from E15.5 mouse embryos and collected in dissection media. Neurons were cultured in neuronal complete medium on coverslips in 24-well plates at high density to reduce glial growth.
goal: to prepare primary neuronal cultures for experiments

title: Transduce Neuronal Cultures with Lentivirus
description: Primary neuronal cultures at day in vitro 4 (DIV4) were transduced with lentivirus at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 2 to express GFP.
goal: to introduce viral constructs into neurons

title: Treat Neurons with Growth Factors
description: Neurons were treated with fibroblast growth factor beta (FGFb) and epidermal growth factor (EGF) for 10 minutes to stimulate cellular responses.
goal: to stimulate neurons with growth factors

title: Perform MTT Reduction Assay for Viability
description: Cortical cultures were seeded in 96-well plates and incubated for 24 hours. MTT was added to a final concentration of 0.25 mg/ml and incubated for 2 hours at 37°C. Formazan precipitates were solubilized in DMSO and absorbance measured at 570 nm to assess cell viability.
goal: to measure culture viability

title: Neuron Lysis and Protein Extraction
description: Neurons were washed in PBS and lysed in RIPA buffer under mild agitation for 1 hour at 4°C. The lysate was clarified by centrifugation at 16,000 g for 20 minutes at 4°C.

title: Protein Quantification by Bradford Assay
description: Protein concentration in the lysate samples was measured using the standard Bradford assay.

title: Western Blotting for Protein Identification
description: Equal amounts of protein samples were diluted with Laemmli buffer, loaded onto SDS-PAGE gels, and transferred to nitrocellulose membranes. Membranes were incubated overnight with primary antibodies in blocking buffer and proteins were detected using ECL prime detection.
goal: to identify and quantify proteins via Western blotting

title: Immunofluorescence Staining and Imaging
description: Neurons were incubated with Mitosox Red to assess mitochondrial superoxide, fixed with paraformaldehyde and sucrose, and imaged using confocal microscopy. GFP-positive neurons were selected for quantification.
